description: This file defines a custom UploadFile class extending Starlette's UploadFile for handling file uploads in FastAPI, including methods for file I/O operations and validation logic, along with some internal utility classes and functions.

classes.name: UploadFile
classes.description: A subclass of Starlette's UploadFile that adds additional metadata and methods for writing, reading, seeking, and closing files asynchronously, tailored for FastAPI request file uploads.
